notes.title: VR Hands and Oculus Support Added
notes.notes:
Hi there! I have fiiinaly added support for vr hands to the game. I am sorry it took so long, did have to learn a few things.

Anyway, you can now duel wield, grab items from your inventory, and throw them to your friends!

In addition, Oculus support has been added.

notes.title: New maps added! And support for Linux and OSX
notes.notes:
Just as the title says, 3 new maps have been added, Office Building, Hotel, and Sewers, each supporting last one standing. In addition, support for OSX and Linux has also been added, and as a bonus, a new weapon! The minigun.
This update makes the game multiplayer compliant with all mobile versions of the game as well.

notes.title: A Battle Royale Mode Has Been Added!
notes.notes:
But this isn't your Grandma's battle royale mode. This is battle royale under the Blood Eclipse, which means that the game does not end when you die. No sir, here a death is not a death at all, and you get to return as a zombie to enact vengeance on your recent murderer. Oh and you'll also have the zombie horde to deal with as well. So a fun little twist on the game I hope you all enjoy!

To start the game in this mode, just make sure that the scenario card "There Can Be Only One" is on top before you host a game. Good luck hunting each other!
